macOS does not expose the Fn key to global shortcuts. If your combo is rejected, try another key (e.g. F13, or Ctrl + Space).

Permissions (macOS)

DictaFlow needs Accessibility to paste at your cursor, and Microphone to record.
Checking…
If paste silently fails after a rebuild, toggle Accessibility off → on for dictaflow. macOS revokes trust when the binary signature changes.
First time setup: click Request Accessibility. macOS will prompt you and add dictaflow to the list — then toggle it on.

HUD Position

The floating pill that shows recording state. Click Edit, drag the pill to a new spot, then Save.
